newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Maxtel to take 25 pct of Zimbabwe's Cosmos.
newsitem.headline: Maxtel to take 25 pct of Zimbabwe's Cosmos.

text.p: South Africa's Maxtel Ltd said on Tuesday that it had reached agreement to acquire 25 percent of Cosmos Cellular (Pvt) Ltd for 8.2 million rand in cash.
Cosmos is one of three cellular phone service providers in Zimbabwe and is expected to have 35,000 subscribers by the end of February 1998.
Earlier this month Maxtel announced it was setting up a joint venture cellular payphone network in Zimbabwe with Cosmos. -- Johannesburg newsroom +27 11 482 1003
